name: Long Beach Public Library Mah-Jongg Club
description: Weekly Mah Jongg open play for community members at the Long Beach Public Library (Long Beach, near Oceanside). Bring your own tiles; library provides space. The current listing does not say American / NMJL; an older library class listing (2022) asked for a 2022 NMJL card.
address: 111 West Park Ave, Long Beach, NY 11561
schedule: Wednesdays 11:00am-12:30pm in the Library Auditorium (Mah-Jongg and Canasta Club on the Nov 2026 calendar, 11am-1pm); Saturday socials at the West branch. Registration shown as required; fee not stated.
